verdict.rationale: Ultrametric is a hosted process-guide and company-context service. It runs no model and relies on the user's own agent host. Its MCP role is server-side: users add https://api.ultrametric.ai/mcp to their agent host's settings. Plugging third-party MCP servers into it so it can call their tools would be the client role of an agent, which this product type does not have, so the story is a category error here.
